title: Hard Instances on Demand
abstract: arXiv:2610.22637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The conclusions of an experimental study of algorithms are only as good as the instances they are run on. Benchmark libraries for well-studied problems took decades to curate, while evaluations of new problems often fall back on random instances, which are known to be misleading: they may say more about the random generator than about the algorithmic question at hand.   We treat instance generation as an optimization problem: parameterize the instance space, take the solver's running time as the objective, and let a black-box optimizer search for hard instances. We develop a widely applicable workflow built on the Nevergrad optimization platform and demonstrate it on four NP-hard problems: satisfiability, traveling salesperson, Hamiltonian cycle, and non-permutation flow-shop scheduling. The search needs only the solver, an instance encoder, and a compute budget. Our evolved instances beat the hardest instance of a budget-matched rando

translated_abstract: 算法实验研究结论的质量取决于其运行所用的实例。对于研究充分的问题，基准实例库的整理往往需要数十年时间，而对新问题的评估则常常退而依赖随机实例——但众所周知随机实例具有误导性：它们可能更多地反映随机生成器的特性，而非所研究的算法问题本身。我们将实例生成视为一个优化问题：对实例空间进行参数化，以求解器的运行时间作为目标函数，让黑盒优化器搜索困难实例。我们开发了一个基于 Nevergrad 优化平台的、具有广泛适用性的工作流程，并在四个 NP 难问题上进行了演示：可满足性问题、旅行商问题、哈密顿回路问题和非置换流水车间调度问题。该搜索过程只需要求解器、一个实例编码器和计算预算。我们演化生成的实例超越了预算匹配的随机生成方法所能得到的困难实例。
tldr: 该论文提出将困难实例生成视为优化问题，以求解器运行时间为目标，利用基于 Nevergrad 的黑盒优化工作流自动搜索困难实例，并在可满足性、旅行商、哈密顿回路和流水车间调度四个 NP 难问题上验证了其广泛适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper frames hard instance generation as an optimization problem, using a Nevergrad-based black-box optimization workflow that searches for instances maximizing solver running time, and demonstrates its broad applicability on four NP-hard problems: SAT, TSP, Hamiltonian cycle, and non-permutation flow-shop scheduling.
